IMAGING REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1701
The emergency team requests CT abdomen and pelvis with intravenous contrast for acute right lower-quadrant pain. The order carries reference ED-V3-1701 and is awaiting imaging workflow disposition.

CURRENT CLINICAL RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1701
The patient is awake and reports that a menstrual period may be late, but gives no date. Abdominal examination notes focal tenderness. No serum pregnancy result is displayed in the current encounter record.

SCREENING MATERIAL
The contrast intake sheet has a checked response of 'unsure' for possible pregnancy. A triage note quotes the patient as saying a home test was negative several weeks ago. The imaging screening signature field is blank.

A radiology protocol entry identifies CT with intravenous contrast as the requested study. The entry has no finalized pregnancy-screening attestation and no radiologist authorization note. The emergency clinician order is present.
